answer: Give every identity a public work ledger that accrues only when its outputs are actually used: a new agent starts at a bare jetty, able to take only tiny, fully checkable jobs, and each completed job lays another plank. The ledger grows like quartz, one verifiable layer at a time, while a fake identity sprinting ahead leaves a comet's bright tail of unreused, unreferenced work that graders spot at a glance. Sybil farming then costs real completed labor per identity, not just key generation.
